topics.justification: Dominated by encrypt/decrypt, key, and data/store/database/file terms, suggesting questions about encrypting application data at rest and managing the encryption keys.
The strongest term is file, with content/read/write/format plus checksum/check, indicating discussions about file processing and verifying file integrity (often alongside encryption).

topics.topic_name: Trust, vendors, and real-world security risk
topics.justification: Words like company, trust, government, customer, claim, risk point to posts about who to trust (vendors/authorities) and practical security implications rather than specific primitives.
hash/hash_function, collision, digest, md5, input/output strongly indicate hash properties, collision concerns, and computing message digests.
server/client/connection/request/browser with http/https/session/authentication suggests web/network security topics around transport security and session handling.

topics.topic_name: Password hashing with salt (bcrypt, rainbow tables)
topics.justification: password, hash, salt, bcrypt and rainbow_table/crack/attacker clearly map to best practices for storing passwords securely and resisting offline attacks.
openssl plus install/build/version/command/path/library/error indicates environment/setup troubleshooting for OpenSSL and related toolchain issues.

topics.topic_name: Public-key cryptography: encryption and digital signatures
topics.justification: public_key/private_key, signature/sign/verify, message/send aligns with asymmetric crypto use cases (confidentiality vs authenticity) and key sharing.

topics.topic_name: Security vs performance (cost, speed, hardware limits)
topics.justification: time/fast/slow/cost/cpu/memory plus crack/attack suggests discussions about computational cost of crypto (or cracking) and tuning parameters.
code/library/implementation/api/class/method plus openssl implies questions about using or implementing cryptographic functionality via programming libraries.

topics.topic_name: Number theory for crypto (primes, factoring, modular arithmetic)
topics.justification: bit/number/prime/factor/integer/modulus/algorithm indicates math-heavy posts around RSA-style number theory operations and complexity.
user/password/login/account/token/email/server suggests application authentication flows, storing credentials, and account access/security management.
understand/explain/read/article/learn/idea points to explanatory Q&A about cryptography concepts rather than a specific algorithm or implementation detail.
security/secure/attack/break/weak/bad/design/scheme implies evaluating whether a design/algorithm is secure and discussing common weaknesses.

topics.topic_name: Block cipher modes, IV/nonce, and padding
topics.justification: block/mode/iv/padding/plaintext/ciphertext/nonce and encrypt/decrypt indicate practical symmetric encryption mode selection and padding/IV handling (incl. related attacks).
password/character/length/guess/entropy/passphrase/crack reflects discussions about how strong passwords are, how to measure entropy, and brute-force difficulty.

topics.topic_name: Key protection on devices (memory/disk access, threat model)
topics.justification: device/memory/disk/store/access/copy/attacker suggests protecting secrets/keys on endpoints against local attackers, memory scraping, or stolen storage.
string/byte/encode/decode/encoding/base64/convert indicates data representation issues common in crypto implementations (bytes vs text encodings).

topics.topic_name: Key sizes and security parameters selection
topics.justification: key/bit/size/length/curve/standard/recommend/choose points to selecting secure parameter sizes (RSA bits, ECC curves, cipher key lengths) and compatibility/support.

topics.topic_name: Secure random number generation (entropy, seeding, PRNG)
topics.justification: generate/random/seed/entropy/prng/state/source aligns with producing cryptographically secure randomness for keys/nonces and avoiding predictable PRNGs.

topics.topic_name: X.509 certificates, signing, and trust chains
topics.justification: certificate/cert/trust/signature/private_key/browser/domain/server/openssl suggests creating/verifying certificates, signing, and managing trust stores/PKI validation.
